announcements.text: The Johns Hopkins Medical Services Corp., Baltimore, Maryland, was awarded a $575,069,699 modification (P00025) to exercise the third option period of a $2,128,056,635 fixed-price commercial contract (HT9402-23-C-0006) to provide comprehensive health care services through the Uniformed Services Family Health Plan, a managed care plan serving approximately 53,025 eligible uniformed services beneficiaries within designated geographic areas. Services include healthcare provider network management, medical management, enrollment, customer services, and related administrative requirements. The base period of performance was Oct. 1, 2023, through Sept. 30, 2024, with nine one-year option periods. Option Period Three runs from Oct. 1, 2026, to Sept. 30, 2027. No funds were obligated at time of award; however, fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance and Medicare-Eligible Retiree Health Care Fund funds were subsequently obligated on Oct. 6, 2026. The contract was awarded noncompetitively pursuant to 10 U.S. Code 1073, Section 722(b)(2). The Defense Health Agency, Managed Care Contracting Division, Aurora, Colorado, is the contracting activity. (Awarded Sept. 30, 2026).

announcements.text: Lockheed Martin Aeronautics Co., Fort Worth, Texas (N0001922C0046), is awarded a $43,673,774 cost-plus-fixed-fee modification (P00025) to a previously awarded contract. This modification adds scope, establishing new contract line items to provide operating system upgrades to the F-35 Lightning II reprogramming laboratory facilities and systems maintained and sustained in support of the Air Force, Navy, Marine Corps, and F-35 cooperative program partners. Work will be performed in Eglin, Florida (80%); and Fort Worth, Texas (20%), and is expected to be completed in April 2030. Fiscal 2026 aircraft procurement (Air Force) funds in the amount of $6,988,754; fiscal 2026 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $6,988,754; and F-35 cooperative program partner funds in the amount of $29,696,266, will be obligated at the time of award. This modification was not competitively procured. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Integer Technologies,* Columbia, South Carolina, is awarded a $23,133,600 cost-plus-fixed-fee contract for the Threat Resilient Integrated Defense for Enhanced Naval Technologies (TRIDENT) program. This contract provides for science and technology investigations into threat-informed zero trust architecture (ZTA) frameworks tailored to the cyber-physical security needs of shipboard power systems. Integer Technologies is forming a team with Florida State University and the Center for Advanced Power Systems to perform the work. The ZTA will enable naval platforms to maintain situational awareness of their cyber-physical state, dynamically adjust their cyber posture, and fight through adversarial attacks while preserving system performance. The program will address the unique constraints of naval power systems, including low-latency requirements for integrated power systems and the integration of legacy and modern equipment. Work will be performed in Columbia, South Carolina, and is expected to be completed in October 2030. The total cumulative value of this contract, including a 36-month base period and a 36-month option period which will start 12 months after execution and run concurrently, is $23,133,600. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) funds in the amount of $10,133,600, fully funding the base period, are obligated at the time of award and will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was competitively procured under long-range broad agency announcement N0001425SB001 entitled "Long-Range Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) for Navy and Marine Corps Science and Technology." Since proposals will be received throughout the year under the Long-Range BAA, the number of proposals received in response to the solicitation is unknown. The Office of Naval Research, Arlington, Virginia, is the contracting activity (N0001427C1303).
